## Summary

Describe the problem and the focused change that solves it.

## Validation

List the exact commands or checks you ran.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is small enough to review confidently.
- [ ] Tests cover behavior changes.
- [ ] Documentation and examples are updated when needed.
- [ ] Scoring changes keep the Python and browser implementations aligned, or the difference is explained.
- [ ] No new write permissions, hosted services, or persistent token storage were added.
